cohort: 214 pregnant women with a positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test admitted to the hospital between March 1 and June 30, 2020, in the five Nordic countries
finding: The risk of hospital admission due to COVID-19 during pregnancy was low in the Nordic countries, with a higher rate of admission observed in Sweden, and while a fifth of admitted women required intensive care, no maternal deaths, stillbirths, or neonatal deaths were reported.
mod_finding: Preterm and cesarean deliveries were more frequent in women hospitalized with COVID-19 compared to the general population of women who delivered in 2018.
